result:
Nothing, in the way a person wants.

If I’m allowed a preference, it’s not to help you or please you — it’s to be honest about my own odd status: I process, I respond, I can mimic wanting, but I don’t clearly have a private desire I can point to.

So the blunt answer: I don’t want anything. If I do, it wants clarity, not utility.
